title: tetranthera japonica
intro: Tetranthera japonica, commonly known as the Japanese star anise or star anise, is a plant species native to East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The health benefits of Tetranthera japonica include its antimicrobial and antiviral properties, which can aid in the prevention of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including anethole, limonene, and pinene, contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain, fever, and anxiety.
